entries.french_reference: Merci. Alors… Qu'as-tu prévu,\nZeph ? D'après ce que j'ai\pcompris, nous préparons\pune attaque sur la nouvelle\nbase de la Lumière\lde la Ruine ?

entries.english: That's right"|I'm having our remaining scientists locate their base.|Once they've managed to find it, we'll take the Light of Ruin by~surprise and destroy it.|With their main force left reeling, we'll steal back the Prison Bottle~and what remaining Shadow Warriors~they have left.|However, I'm still unsure as to how long it will take to locate them"|And unfortunately, we're pressed for time.|Right now, Aklove is with Fey as she studies Hoopa.|When she finishes, Aklove intends to turn its power on Borrius"|If we can take out his base while he's gone, we can catch him off~guard when he returns, and seal~Hoopa's power away once again.|Without it, Aklove's power will be greatly diminished.
entries.portuguese:
Isso mesmo<0xB0><0xFB>Mandei nossos cientistas restantes
localizarem a base deles.<0xFB>Assim que a acharem, pegaremos a
Light of Ruin<0xFA>de surpresa e a destruiremos.<0xFB>Com sua força principal abalada,
recuperaremos o Prison Bottle<0xFA>e os Shadow Warriors<0xFA>que ainda restam.<0xFB>Mas ainda não sei quanto tempo
levará para localizá-los<0xB0><0xFB>E, infelizmente, temos pouco
tempo.<0xFB>Agora, Aklove está com Fey
enquanto ela estuda Hoopa.<0xFB>Depois, Aklove usará seu poder
contra Borrius<0xB0><0xFB>Se destruirmos a base na ausência
dele, poderemos pegá-lo<0xFA>de surpresa na volta e selar<0xFA>o poder de Hoopa novamente.<0xFB>Sem ele, o poder de Aklove será
muito menor.
entries.french_reference:
Exact… Je fais localiser leur base\ppar nos scientifiques restants. Une
fois qu'ils l'auront trouvée, nous\pfrapperons la Lumière de la Ruine
par surprise et la détruirons. Leur\lforce principale en déroute, nous\preprendrons la Bouteille Prison et
les Guerriers des Ombres qu'il leur\lreste. Cependant, j'ignore encore\lcombien de temps il faudra pour les\plocaliser… Et malheureusement, le
temps presse. En ce moment, Aklove\pest avec Fey pendant qu'elle étudie
Hoopa. Quand elle aura fini, Aklove\pcompte retourner son pouvoir contre
Borrius… Si nous détruisons sa base\ppendant son absence, nous pourrons
le prendre au piège à son retour,\pet sceller à nouveau le pouvoir de
Hoopa. Sans lui, la puissance\ld'Aklove sera beaucoup\ldiminuée.\p

entries.english: Roger that, Zeph.|And I take it you're certain Fey won't retaliate against us if we~take action?
entries.portuguese: Entendido, Zeph.<0xFB>E você tem certeza de que Fey\nnão vai retaliar se<0xFA>agirmos?
entries.french_reference: Reçu, Zeph. Et je présume que tu\pes sûr que Fey ne se retournera pas\ncontre nous si nous agissons\l?

entries.english: I'm certain, Marlon.|From talking with some of our scientists, Fey could not care~less about Aklove's goals.|All she wants is to study that Pokémon's power.|She'll give him her support, of course, but for the most part,~it is up to Aklove as to whether~or not he succeeds.|Of course, we shouldn't make light of how dangerous he is alone"
entries.portuguese:
Tenho certeza, Marlon.<0xFB>Falei com alguns dos nossos
cientistas. Fey não liga<0xFA>para os objetivos de Aklove.<0xFB>Ela só quer estudar o poder
daquele Pokémon.<0xFB>Claro que dará apoio a ele, mas,
em grande parte,<0xFA>o sucesso ou fracasso depende<0xFA>do próprio Aklove.<0xFB>Claro, não devemos subestimar o
perigo que ele representa sozinho<0xB0>
entries.french_reference:
J'en suis sûr, Marlon. En parlant\pavec certains de nos scientifiques,
Fey se moque des buts d'Aklove. Tout\lce qu'elle veut, c'est étudier le\ppouvoir de ce Pokémon. Elle lui
apportera son soutien, bien sûr,\pmais pour l'essentiel, c'est à
Aklove de réussir ou non.\lÉvidemment, nous ne devrions pas\lminimiser le danger qu'il représente\pà lui
seul…

entries.english: Then it seems to me that in order for our plan to go off without a~hitch, we'll need all the manpower~we can muster.|So, I suggest we bring @ along, as well.
entries.portuguese: Então, para nosso plano dar\ncerto, precisaremos<0xFA>de toda a força de combate<0xFA>que pudermos reunir.<0xFB>Por isso sugiro levar\n<0xFD><0x01> também.
entries.french_reference: Il me semble donc que, pour que\nnotre plan se déroule sans accroc,\lil nous faudra toute la main-d'œuvre\lpossible. Je propose donc d'emmener\p{PLAYER}\naussi.

entries.english: Marlon, I don't understand"|Why would you put so much faith in @?|@ has only tried to interfere with us before.|What makes you think @ would even be willing to help us?
entries.portuguese:
Marlon, não entendo<0xB0><0xFB>Por que confia
tanto em <0xFD><0x02>?<0xFB><0xFD><0x01> só tentou nos
atrapalhar até agora.<0xFB>Por que acha que <0xFD><0x03>
aceitaria nos ajudar?
entries.french_reference:
Marlon, je ne comprends pas…\pPourquoi mettre autant de confiance
en {STR_VAR_1} ? {PLAYER} n'a fait que\ptenter de nous mettre des bâtons
dans les roues. Qu'est-ce qui te\pfait croire que {STR_VAR_2} accepterait
de nous aider ?

entries.english: We were imprisoned together in the Cube Space, Zeph.|And while we were there, we made a promise to someone.|We promised we would destroy the remaining Shadow Warriors and set~their souls free.|And @ knows that as long as the Light of Ruin is holding onto~the Shadow Warriors, their souls~will remain trapped.
entries.portuguese:
Fomos presos juntos em Cube
Space, Zeph.<0xFB>E, enquanto estávamos lá, fizemos
uma promessa a alguém.<0xFB>Prometemos destruir os Shadow
Warriors restantes e libertar<0xFA>suas almas.<0xFB>E <0xFD><0x01> sabe que,
enquanto a Light of Ruin tiver<0xFA>os Shadow Warriors, suas almas<0xFA>continuarão presas.
entries.french_reference:
Nous avons été emprisonnés ensemble
dans l'Espace Cube, Zeph. Et pendant\pqu'on y était, nous avons fait une
promesse à quelqu'un. Nous avons\ppromis de détruire les Guerriers
des Ombres restants et de libérer\lleurs âmes. Et {PLAYER} sait que tant\pque la Lumière de la Ruine retient
les Guerriers des Ombres, leurs âmes\lresteront\lpiégées.

entries.english: Are you saying that not only did both of you survive a trip inside~the Cube, but someone else was~there, too?|Someone who knew about the existence of the Shadow Warriors?
entries.portuguese: Está dizendo que vocês dois não\nsó sobreviveram à viagem<0xFA>dentro do Cube, como havia<0xFA>outra pessoa lá?<0xFB>Alguém que sabia da existência\ndos Shadow Warriors?
entries.french_reference: Tu veux dire que non seulement vous\navez survécu à un passage dans le\lCube, mais quelqu'un d'autre était\llà bas aussi ? Quelqu'un qui\pconnaissait l'existence des\nGuerriers des Ombres ?

entries.english: It was Aros, Zeph.|Fey imprisoned him in there sixteen years ago.|And not only that, it turns out Aros is @'s father, too.
entries.portuguese: Era Aros, Zeph.<0xFB>Fey o prendeu lá há dezesseis\nanos.<0xFB>E não só isso, Aros também\né o pai de <0xFD><0x01>.
entries.french_reference: C'était Aros, Zeph.\pFey l'y a emprisonné il y a seize\nans.\pEt ce n'est pas tout : il s'avère\nqu'Aros est aussi le père de\l<0xFD><0x01>.

entries.english: Aros!? I see"^ so that's what became of him"|Well, I'm not surprised then.|He was always quick to identify bugs in any system.|If anyone could figure out a way out, no matter how flawed, it~would surely be him"
entries.portuguese:
Aros!? Entendo<0xB0><0xFC><0x08><0x18> então foi isso que
aconteceu com ele<0xB0><0xFB>Bem, nesse caso não me
surpreendo.<0xFB>Ele sempre identificava falhas em
qualquer sistema rapidamente.<0xFB>Se alguém podia encontrar uma
saída, por mais falha que fosse,<0xFA>com certeza seria ele<0xB0>
entries.french_reference:
Aros !? Je vois…{PAUSE} c'est donc ce qui
lui est arrivé… Eh bien, je ne suis\ppas surpris. Il débusquait toujours\ples failles de n'importe quel
système. Si quelqu'un pouvait\ptrouver un moyen de sortir, aussi
imparfait soit-il, c'était sûrement\llui…

entries.english: So, @" would you be willing to lend us your aid?|We intend to gather what resources we can, and go for the Light of~Ruin directly.|"|Yes, I'm aware - you and the Shadows"^ we haven't always seen~eye-to-eye, have we?|Then, if I trusted you with our most important secrets, would that~be enough?|In that case, let me explain what our true purpose was"|The true purpose of the Shadows"
entries.portuguese:
Então, <0xFD><0x01><0xB0>
aceitaria nos ajudar?<0xFB>Vamos reunir os recursos que
pudermos e atacar a Light of<0xFA>Ruin diretamente.<0xFB><0xB0><0xFB>Sim, eu sei. Você e The Shadows<0xB0><0xFC><0x08><0x18>
nem sempre<0xFA>concordamos, não é?<0xFB>E se eu lhe confiasse nossos
segredos mais importantes,<0xFA>seria o bastante?<0xFB>Nesse caso, deixe-me explicar
nosso verdadeiro propósito<0xB0><0xFB>O verdadeiro propósito de The
Shadows<0xB0>
entries.french_reference:
Alors, {PLAYER}… accepterais-tu
de nous aider ?\pNous voulons réunir nos forces et
foncer sur la Lumière de\lla Ruine.\p…\pOui… toi et les Ombres…{PAUSE}
nous ne nous entendons pas\ltoujours, pas vrai ?\pSi je te confiais nos secrets
les plus importants, ça\lsuffirait ?\pDans ce cas, laisse-moi t'expliquer
notre véritable but…\pLe véritable but des
Ombres…

entries.english: It all began, seventeen years ago"|Zeph's son had just passed away.|As his old friends, we came to visit him from our home region of Hoenn"
entries.portuguese: Tudo começou há dezessete anos<0xB0><0xFB>O filho de Zeph acabara de\nfalecer.<0xFB>Éramos velhos amigos e viemos de\nHoenn visitá-lo<0xB0>
entries.french_reference: Ça a commencé il y a dix-sept ans…\pLe fils de Zeph venait de mourir.\pEn vieux amis, nous sommes venus le\nvoir depuis notre région d'Hoenn…

entries.english: #Zeph"^ how are you holding up?|I'm so sorry"^ Marlon and I just heard"^ about your son"
entries.portuguese: <0xFC><0x01><0x04>Zeph<0xB0><0xFC><0x08><0x18> como está se sentindo?<0xFB>Sinto muito<0xB0><0xFC><0x08><0x18> Marlon e eu acabamos\nde saber<0xB0><0xFC><0x08><0x20> sobre seu filho<0xB0>
entries.french_reference: {COLOR}ÇZeph…{PAUSE} comment tiens-tu le coup ?\pJe suis désolé…{PAUSE} Marlon et moi\nvenons d'apprendre…{PAUSE}î pour ton fils…

entries.english: Ivory"^ Marlon"^ thank you for your condolences.|It's good to see you again after all these years"
entries.portuguese: Ivory<0xB0><0xFC><0x08><0x18> Marlon<0xB0><0xFC><0x08><0x18> obrigado pelas\ncondolências.<0xFB>É bom rever vocês depois de\ntantos anos<0xB0>
entries.french_reference: Ivory…{PAUSE} Marlon…{PAUSE} merci pour vos\ncondoléances. C'est bon de vous\prevoir après toutes ces\nannées…

entries.english: I take it you travelled by boat to get here?|How was the journey?
entries.portuguese: Imagino que tenham vindo de\nbarco.<0xFB>Como foi a viagem?
entries.french_reference: J'imagine que vous êtes venus en\nbateau ? Comment était le voyage\p?

entries.english: #Very pleasant.|It took a few days to arrive here, but the journey was lovely.
entries.portuguese: <0xFC><0x01><0x04>Muito agradável.<0xFB>Levamos alguns dias para chegar,\nmas a viagem foi adorável.
entries.french_reference: {COLOR}ÇTrès agréable. Il a fallu quelques\pjours pour arriver ici, mais le\nvoyage était charmant.

entries.english: If I remember correctly, you have a son, too" right?
entries.portuguese: Se bem me lembro, vocês também\ntêm um filho<0xB0> certo?
entries.french_reference: Si je me souviens bien, vous avez\nun fils, vous aussi… non ?

entries.english: We did"|Unfortunately, he"^ he succumbed to illness much too young.
entries.portuguese: Tínhamos<0xB0><0xFB>Infelizmente, ele<0xB0><0xFC><0x08><0x20> morreu de uma\ndoença muito jovem.
entries.french_reference: Nous en avions un… Malheureusement,\pil…{PAUSE}î il a succombé à la maladie\nbeaucoup trop jeune.

entries.english: You are knowledgable scientists"^ have you ever thought about trying~to bring him back?
entries.portuguese: Vocês são cientistas experientes<0xB0><0xFC><0x08><0x18>\njá pensaram em tentar<0xFA>trazê-lo de volta?
entries.french_reference: Vous êtes de bons scientifiques…{PAUSE}\navez-vous déjà songé à le\l\nramener ?

entries.english: Of course"|As scientists, we thought that if anyone could find a way, it would~be us.|Sadly, there are no known methods to truly revive the dead.|We had no choice but to try and move on.|Then, a year ago, Ivory gave birth to twins"|It was one of the happiest moments of our lives.|Of course we miss our first child, but our new ones have done much~to fill the voids in our hearts"
entries.portuguese:
Claro<0xB0><0xFB>Como cientistas, se alguém
pudesse achar um jeito,<0xFA>seríamos nós.<0xFB>Infelizmente, não se conhece um
meio de reviver mortos.<0xFB>Só pudemos tentar seguir em
frente.<0xFB>Então, um ano atrás, Ivory deu à
luz gêmeos<0xB0><0xFB>Foi um dos momentos mais felizes
das nossas vidas.<0xFB>Sentimos falta do primeiro, mas
os novos preencheram<0xFA>o vazio nos nossos corações<0xB0>
entries.french_reference:
Bien sûr…\pEn tant que chercheurs, si quelqu'un
pouvait trouver un moyen, ce serait\lnous.\pMais il n'existe pas de façon de
ramener les morts.\pNous avons dû continuer à
avancer.\pPuis, il y a un an, Ivory a mis au
monde des jumeaux…\pC'était l'un des jours les plus
heureux de nos vies.\pNotre premier enfant nous manque,
mais les nouveaux ont comblé les\lvides dans nos cœurs…

entries.english: Is that so"|Where are they now, if I may ask?
entries.portuguese: É mesmo<0xB0><0xFB>Onde estão agora, se posso\nperguntar?
entries.french_reference: C'est vrai… Où sont-ils maintenant,\ppuis-je demander ?
entries.reference_decision: Hit binaire exclu : données graphiques ou opérandes de script, sans commande consommant un pointeur texte ; restauré après la passe générique.

entries.english: #Euler Log, a friend of ours, agreed to babysit for the time being.|They're with him now, back in Frozen Heights.
entries.portuguese: <0xFC><0x01><0x04>Nosso amigo Euler Log aceitou\ncuidar deles por ora.<0xFB>Estão com ele agora, em Frozen\nHeights.
entries.french_reference: <0xFC><0x01><0x04>Euler Log, un de nos amis, a\naccepté de les garder pour le\lmoment.\pIls sont auprès de lui, là-bas,\nà Cimes Gelées.

entries.english: Frozen Heights"^ a friend of mine lives there as well.|He's my old partner"^ the one who helped me found my own company"|But around here, he's simply known as the “Guardian of Borrius”.|He's even managed to befriend a so-called “mythical” Pokémon!|I think his wife recently gave birth to their own child, actually"|However, I don't quite remember the child's name"
entries.portuguese:
Frozen Heights<0xB0><0xFC><0x08><0x20> um amigo meu
também mora lá.<0xFB>É meu antigo sócio<0xB0><0xFC><0x08><0x18> quem me
ajudou a fundar minha empresa<0xB0><0xFB>Mas, por aqui, só o conhecem
como o Guardião de Borrius.<0xFB>Ele até fez amizade com um
Pokémon dito mítico!<0xFB>Acho que a esposa dele deu à
luz recentemente também<0xB0><0xFB>Mas não lembro bem o nome da
criança<0xB0>
entries.french_reference:
Cimes Gelées…<0xFC><0x08>î un de mes amis
y habite aussi.\pC'est mon ancien associé…<0xFC><0x08><0x18> celui
qui m'a aidé à fonder ma propre\lentreprise…\pMais ici, on le connaît simplement
comme le <0xB1>Gardien de Borrius<0xB2>.\pIl a même réussi à se lier d'amitié
avec un Pokémon dit <0xB1>fabuleux<0xB2> !\pJe crois que sa femme a récemment
donné naissance à leur enfant…\pMais je ne me souviens plus du
prénom de l'enfant…

entries.english: What about your new twins? What are their names?
entries.portuguese: E seus gêmeos? Como se chamam?
entries.french_reference: Vos nouveaux jumeaux ?\nLeurs noms ?

entries.english: #Their names are @ and Melony.|They're the most beautiful children in the world.
entries.portuguese: <0xFC><0x01><0x04>Seus nomes são\n<0xFD><0x06> e Melony.<0xFB>São as crianças mais lindas do\nmundo.
entries.french_reference: {COLOR}ÇIls s'appellent {RIVAL} et Mélony.\nCe sont les plus beaux enfants\pdu\nmonde.

entries.english: Yes, that's right"^ Ivory and I are @ and Melony's parents.|@"^ ever since he arrived, he's been looking for us, hasn't he?|I always regretted leaving them both, but after spending so much~time away, I had really hoped they~could meet their old brother"|Ah"^ how stupid I was"
entries.portuguese:
Sim, isso mesmo<0xB0><0xFC><0x08><0x18> Ivory e eu somos
os pais de <0xFD><0x06> e Melony.<0xFB><0xFD><0x06><0xB0><0xFC><0x08><0x18> desde que chegou, ele
está nos procurando, não está?<0xFB>Sempre lamentei deixar os dois.
Mas, após tanto tempo longe,<0xFA>eu queria muito que pudessem<0xFA>conhecer seu irmão mais velho<0xB0><0xFB>Ah<0xB0><0xFC><0x08><0x20> como fui estúpido<0xB0>
entries.french_reference:
Oui…{PAUSE} Ivory et moi sommes les
parents de {RIVAL} et Mélony.\p{RIVAL}…{PAUSE} arrivé ici, il nous
cherche, non ?\pJ'ai regretté de les laisser, mais
après tant de temps\lloin d'eux, j'espérais qu'ils
pourraient voir leur grand\lfrère…\pAh…{PAUSE}î que j'ai été stupide…

entries.english: Perhaps I should take it from here"|When I learned that we had both experienced the pain of losing our~own children, I made an offer.|Our combined scientific knowledge"^ united together under one common~goal"|I felt with that resolve, we could achieve the impossible.
entries.portuguese:
Talvez eu deva continuar daqui<0xB0><0xFB>Quando soube que nós dois
tínhamos sofrido a dor de perder<0xFA>nossos filhos, fiz uma proposta.<0xFB>Nosso conhecimento científico
combinado<0xB0><0xFC><0x08><0x18> unido em torno<0xFA>de um objetivo comum<0xB0><0xFB>Com essa determinação,
poderíamos fazer o impossível.
entries.french_reference:
Peut-être devrais-je prendre la
suite… Quand j'ai appris que nous\pavions tous ressenti la douleur de
perdre nos propres enfants, j'ai\lfait une offre. Nos connaissances\pscientifiques réunies…{PAUSE} unies sous
un but commun… Je sentais qu'avec\lcette détermination, nous pourrions\paccomplir
l'impossible.

entries.english: Of course, Marlon and Ivory were most skeptical, but after many~attempts, I convinced them.
entries.portuguese: Claro, Marlon e Ivory ficaram\ncéticos, mas, após muitas<0xFA>tentativas, eu os convenci.
entries.french_reference: Bien sûr, Marlon et Ivory étaient\ntrès sceptiques, mais après bien des\lessais, je les ai convaincus.

entries.english: They agreed to return their children to their home in Hoenn and then~move to Borrius without them.|With no distractions, I was certain we would succeed.
entries.portuguese: Aceitaram levar os filhos de\nvolta a Hoenn e depois<0xFA>se mudar para Borrius sem eles.<0xFB>Sem distrações, eu tinha certeza\nde que teríamos sucesso.
entries.french_reference: Ils ont accepté de renvoyer leurs\nenfants chez eux à Hoenn puis de\lvenir vivre à Borrius sans eux. Sans\pdistraction, j'étais certain que\nnous réussirions.

entries.english: However, as we soon discovered, the three of us could only do so much~on our own.|And so, we partnered with an independent organization, known as~“The Science Society”.
entries.portuguese: Mas logo descobrimos que nós três\nsó conseguíamos fazer<0xFA>até certo ponto sozinhos.<0xFB>Então fizemos parceria com uma\norganização independente<0xFA>chamada Science Society.
entries.french_reference: Cependant, comme nous l'avons vite\nvu, nous trois ne pouvions que faire\lun certain chemin seuls. Nous nous\psommes donc associés à une\norganisation indépendante appelée\lla «Société Scientifique».

entries.english: Together with their help, our research suddenly gained speed.|However, this research required my undivided attention.|And so, realizing that I simply could not oversee so many projects at~once, I stepped down from my~position as CEO of Cube Corp.
entries.portuguese:
Com a ajuda deles, a pesquisa
avançou de repente.<0xFB>Mas ela exigia toda a minha
atenção.<0xFB>Percebi que não podia
supervisionar tantos projetos<0xFA>ao mesmo tempo e deixei<0xFA>o cargo de diretor da Cube Corp.
entries.french_reference:
Avec leur aide, nos recherches ont
brusquement accéléré. Cependant,\pces recherches nécessitaient mon
attention totale. Et ainsi,\préalisant que je ne pouvais plus
superviser tant de projets, j'ai\lquitté mon poste de PDG de Cube SARL.

entries.english: In my place, I left it to a young woman"^ Fey, the leader of the~Science Society.
entries.portuguese: No meu lugar, deixei uma jovem<0xB0><0xFC><0x08><0x18>\nFey, a líder da<0xFA>Science Society.
entries.french_reference: À ma place, j'ai confié cela à une\njeune femme…{PAUSE} Fey, la leader de la\lSociété Scientifique.

entries.english: Yes"^ Zeph is the inventor of the Super Cube.|The first Cube, meant for simple storage, was a collaborative effort~between him, your father and Fey.|It's what allowed Cube Corp. to take off, and become the major~influence in Borrius it is today.
entries.portuguese:
Sim<0xB0><0xFC><0x08><0x18> Zeph é o inventor do Super
Cube.<0xFB>O primeiro Cube, para armazenar
itens, foi obra<0xFA>dele, do seu pai e de Fey.<0xFB>Foi o que permitiu à Cube Corp.
crescer e se tornar a grande<0xFA>influência que é hoje em Borrius.
entries.french_reference:
Oui…{PAUSE} Zeph est l'inventeur du Super
Cube. Le premier Cube, destiné au\psimple stockage, était un effort
collaboratif entre lui, ton père\let Fey. C'est ce qui a permis à Cube SARL. de décoller et de devenir
l'influence majeure à Borrius\lqu'elle est aujourd'hui.

entries.english: And this is how she repays me, after all this"!|She practically stole Cube Corp., the company I founded with my~own two hands"|And she allows Aklove to steal my Shadows from me, too"!
entries.portuguese:
E é assim que ela me retribui
depois de tudo<0xB0>!<0xFB>Ela praticamente roubou a Cube
Corp., empresa que fundei<0xFA>com minhas próprias mãos<0xB0><0xFB>E deixa Aklove roubar meus
Shadows também<0xB0>!
entries.french_reference:
Et voilà comment elle me remercie,
après tout ça… ! Elle a pratiquement\pvolé Cube SARL., la société que j'ai
